hotels.address: Sri Beechupally Anjaneya Swamy Temple Premises, NH-44, Beechupally, Itikyal Mandal, Jogulamba Gadwal District, Telangana - 509125, India
hotels.about: Beechupally Temple Guest Rooms are basic accommodation facilities provided by the temple management for pilgrims visiting Sri Beechupally Anjaneya Swamy Temple. The temple has a limited number of rooms available, generally allotted on a first-come, first-served basis. These rooms are mainly intended for devotees visiting the temple and the Krishna River ghats. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}
